_about: TiviBro's own words, translated the same way everywhere.  terms: English texts the app shows on their own (a menu item, a section, a button); each language's word for one is whatever its dictionary already says (app/js/lang, else service/editor/lang), so there is nothing to keep in step here.  scripts/i18n-todo.js puts the terms a language doesn't have yet first, and gives every text the words for the terms it uses.  notes: what a term means, for whoever translates it.

notes.Catch-up: the provider's recordings of programmes already shown, to watch afterwards
notes.Live pause: pausing live TV and carrying on from there (timeshift)
notes.Rewind buffer: the last part of a live channel kept on the TV to go back in
notes.Network helper: TiviBro's small background service on the TV that fetches streams and guides
notes.Web editor: TiviBro's page in a computer's or phone's browser for changing the TV's setup
notes.Smart clean-up: tools that hide clutter in a provider's channel list
notes.Send to TV: the web editor's button that applies the changes on the TV
notes.Public guide fill-in: free community TV guides used for channels the provider gives no guide for
notes.Up next: the screen offering the next episode when one ends
notes.Programme: one TV show at one time in the guide (a listing)
